summary: Backend: 19/19 tests passed (1 skipped as public endpoint can't reliably force an empty field). Frontend: full signup -> create check -> run-now -> verdict flow works end-to-end. Verdict PASSes via jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos with fingerprint {record_count: 200}. Testids all present. Two minor issues found around post-logout navigation and unhandled 401 rejections.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking Sign out on /dashboard, Protected wrapper renders <Navigate to='/login'> because setUser(false) happens synchronously before nav('/') resolves. Result: user lands on /login instead of the landing page /.

integration_issues.issue: runNow() schedules setTimeout(load, 4000) and setInterval(load, 1500). If the user signs out (or unmounts) while polling is in flight, the axios GET /api/checks/:id returns 401 as an UNHANDLED promise rejection, which triggers the CRA runtime-error overlay in dev. Should wrap load() in try/catch or clear timers on unmount.
Dashboard.load() has no .catch — a stale token or race condition producing 401 will bubble as unhandled rejection.

action_items: Wrap Dashboard.load() and CheckDetail.load() in try/catch (or add a global axios 401 handler that clears token + navigates to /login) so background 401s do not surface as uncaught runtime errors.
Clear the setInterval/setTimeout in CheckDetail.runNow() on unmount and stop scheduling new loads once running is cleared.

Fix Nav.onLogout: navigate to '/' with `nav('/', {replace:true})` BEFORE calling logout(), or logout() should return a promise/tick so that Protected does not race to /login. Alternative: change Protected to redirect to '/' when user is false (would also match PublicOnly semantics).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py mixes many concerns (auth, CRUD, executor, verdict logic) in one file (~490 lines) — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth.py, checks.py, executor.py, models.py) before adding more connectors.
CORS is configured AFTER app.include_router(api). starlette middleware added after routes still works for FastAPI, but conventionally should be added before include_router. Not blocking.

In server.execute_check, if resp.text raises or resp.json() raises AFTER a >=400 status, error_details is only set for the >=400 branch; body may still be assigned within the try; overall control flow is fine but could be simplified.
Frontend api.js has NO 401 interceptor — every consumer must handle 401 manually. Recommend a response interceptor that on 401 clears rp_token and redirects to /login.
NewCheck.jsx sends bearer_token:null and json_path:null (rather than omitting). Pydantic accepts because both are Optional[str], so OK.
AuthProvider initial state uses user=null then setReady(true) after /auth/me; Protected only guards on `!ready` but `!user` still shows Loading appropriately. OK.

success_rate.frontend: 95% - all core flows work; 2 minor post-logout/polling issues

test_credentials: None seeded. Tests create fresh accounts using pattern test_<slug>_<uuid>@example.com / pass123.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is solid. If retesting, run pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py; each run generates unique emails so no cleanup needed. Frontend flow via jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos gives verdict PASS with record_count=200 within ~5s. When testing logout, use nav('/', replace:true) expectation or accept /login as valid until the race is fixed.
rca of the issue: Post-logout race: Nav.onLogout calls logout() (setUser(false)) then nav('/'). React re-renders Routes with user=false; the current /dashboard route's Protected wrapper synchronously returns <Navigate to='/login' replace/> and that navigation wins over the imperative nav('/'). Fix by navigating first or by using a synchronous replace navigation before setting user state, or by making Protected redirect to '/' instead of '/login'.
